Frequency Once per Hour

Requirements You are in Hybrid or Animal Form

With a powerful growl, howl, or roar, you attempt to frighten up to 5 targets within 30 feet. The targets must attempt a will save against your Class DC or Spell DC, whichever is higher. This is treated as a Demoralize and regardless of your result, the targets are temporarily immune to your attempts to Demoralize it or any attempt of Frightening Call for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.
